Quirk: Given Out.name: Quirk: Given Out
Quirk: Given Out.description: 🫥 Your Quirk gave out at Quirk Strain 100. Every use fizzles until your Strain falls below 60: rest or sleep brings it back. It costs no health.
Quirk: Given Out.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's Quirk has given out: any attempt to use it, light or hard, fizzles with nothing coming out, and costs no health. Only their own Drawback's symptoms linger.
